description: Defines a templated class 'general_task_worker' for managing a single-threaded task worker with configurable queue policies and wait policies, along with associated executor classes and factory functions.

classes.name: general_task_worker
classes.description: A templated class implementing a single-thread worker with a configurable task queue and wait policy.

classes.name: general_task_worker_executor
classes.description: An executor class that wraps a 'general_task_worker' to provide task execution and deferral capabilities.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the task worker if it is running.

methods.name: wait_pending_tasks
methods.description: Waits for all currently enqueued tasks to complete.

methods.name: make_blocking_pop_task
methods.description: Creates a task for blocking pop operation from the queue.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a task immediately if in the same thread, otherwise defers it.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Defers a task to the worker queue.

methods.name: can_run_task_inline
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the same as the worker thread for inline execution.
